85530.title: The Fox
85530.synopsis: In this darkly comic folktale, an affable foxhunter encounters a talking Fox who offers him an opportunity to transform his fiancee into the perfect woman.
85530.cast: Emily Browning, Jai Courtney, Olivia Colman

85534.title: Popiwa
85534.synopsis: Three humble friends discover a lost monkey, and when they return it in exchange for a generous reward, their lives change overnight. Suddenly rich, they dive into a world of luxury, wild adventures, and hilarious situations that put their friendship to the test.
85534.cast: Carlos Cruz, Luis Polonia, Papi Rosswil

85535.title: Sanjog
85535.synopsis: At the heart of SANJOG is a playful take on love, marriage and family expectations. Harman believes one small lie will save him from marriage, but instead finds himself trapped in a world of fake relationships, confused families and situations he never planned for. Filled with mistaken identities, outrageous situations, romance, humour and heartfelt moments, SANJOG is designed as a complete Punjabi theatrical entertainer - a film that brings together the energy of a romantic comedy with the warmth and chaos of a family story.

85537.title: Chakkven
85537.synopsis: Chakven is the story of a respected Punjabi village family known for its values, love, and loyalty across generations. The family is still dealing with the loss of their eldest son, Guri, who lost his life due to political rivalries. His best friend, Sukha (Kartar Cheema), returns home after serving seven years in prison following the same incident. Sukha has always treated Guri?s younger brother, Jassa (Vishal Brar), as his own brother. After spending years behind bars, Sukha now dreams of leaving his past behind and starting a new life in Canada. Jassa, once a hot-tempered young man involved in village politics and conflicts, decides to change his ways for the sake of his family. Like many Punjabi families hoping for a better future abroad, Jassa sends his newlywed wife, Ravi, to Canada. Sukha also eventually moves to Canada, leaving Jassa alone in Punjab to look after his family, home, and responsibilities.    As time passes, the struggles of student life in Canada and the distance between Jassa and Ravi begin to affect their relationship. Two years later, Jassa receives shocking news that Ravi has become involved in the escort business. Unable to accept what he has heard, Jassa?s old temper returns, and he decides to travel to Canada to find out the truth and confront his wife. Things become even more complicated because Sukha, who has always considered Ravi his own sister, finds himself caught in the middle of the situation. With Jassa?s anger, Sukha?s loyalty, and Ravi?s unexpected circumstances, the story takes a series of emotional, humorous, and unpredictable turns. Chakven is a Punjabi family entertainer that brings together friendship, brotherhood, relationships, emotions, and situational comedy, set against the changing lives of Punjabi families between Punjab and Canada.
85537.cast: Harpreet Bains, Kartar Cheema, Vishal Brar

85538.title: Romeo + Juliet 30th Anniversary
85538.cast: Claire Danes, John Leguizamo, Leonardo DiCaprio

85545.title: Jean-Michel Basquiat
85545.synopsis: Jean-Michel Basquiat is a reclamation of what has been lost in the legacy of a globally renowned artist. Through untold memories from close friends and family, never-before-seen works, and rare archival imagery, this film demystifies the story of Basquiat and discovers the man behind it all, Jean-Michel.

85551.title: Many Many Happy Returns
85551.synopsis: The film centers around a group of close-knit childhood friends reuniting in their picturesque hometown for an elaborate, week-long wedding celebration. As old sparks fly and long-buried secrets surface, the joyful occasion quickly turns chaotic, forcing the friends to confront unresolved heartbreaks, career anxieties, and the changing dynamics of their relationships.

85556.title: Vrushakarma
85556.synopsis: In a desperate quest to decode ancient cave carvings, a treasure hunter hungry for untold riches, an obsessed archaeologist, and a devoted history student race against time to unravel a prophecy tied to royal lineage and the impending apocalypse, confronting the forces of destiny and evil along the way.

85571.title: Dune: Part One & Dune: Part Two Double Feature

85581.title: 70 Syaal
85581.synopsis: Seeking peace for his dying father, an NRI returns with his family to their ancestral village in Punjab. Their homecoming turns into a nightmare when a malevolent supernatural entity targets his newborn child and wife. As he races against time to protect his family, he uncovers a brutal 70-year-old generational curse that has haunted them for decades.

85583.title: AMC Screen Unseen: November 16
85583.synopsis: AMC Screen Unseen, where guests can watch a never-before-seen film. We will share the movie’s MPA rating ahead of time, but the feature presentation will remain a mystery until showtime. Share your reaction after the movie with #AMCScreenUnseen on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads and X.

85592.title: Project Hail Mary (RE26)
85592.synopsis: Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.
85592.advisory: AMC has been advised that this film contains sequences with flashing lights that may affect photosensitive viewers.

85594.title: Maserati: The Brothers
85594.synopsis: The name Maserati, renowned in the world of car racing and manufacturing, is more than just that. This is the story of the Maserati family company's modest, yet proud beginning, and the journey they took for that name to become so established - from its founding in 1914, to the struggle to keep the business and their lives intact, to the legend it is today.
85594.cast: Andy Garcia, Anthony Hopkins, Jessica Alba

85597.title: Prince 3121 Las Vegas Live
85597.synopsis: Prepare for an electrifying, once in a lifetime concert experience as Prince commands the stage in 3121 Las Vegas Live. At the height of his legendary Las Vegas residency, Prince delivers a breathtaking showcase of unparalleled musicianship, explosive energy, dazzling guitar work, and unforgettable performances. Blending funk, rock, soul, R&B, and pop, he tears through hits, fan favorites, deep cuts, and extended jams with the spontaneity and brilliance that defined Prince as one of the greatest performers of all time. Whether you've been a lifelong Prince fan or are discovering his genius for the first time, this is Prince unleashed, and an essential experience for every generation.

85598.title: Cosmic Samson
85598.synopsis: A pizza delivery guy's ordinary day takes an extraordinary turn when strange forces pull him into a hidden fantasy realm, launching him on an epic adventure beyond anything he's ever imagined.
85598.cast: Alphonse Puthren, Miya George, Sandeep Pradeep

85600.title: Ringu & Ju-On: The Grudge Double Feature
85600.synopsis: Two of Japan's most iconic horror films return to the big screen for one terrifying double feature! In RINGU, a television journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it within seven days, leading her to a chilling encounter with the vengeful spirit Sadako. In JU-ON: THE GRUDGE, a social worker enters a seemingly ordinary home, only to discover a sinister curse and the terrifying presence of Kayako. Together, these groundbreaking J-horror classics redefined the genre with their haunting imagery, relentless suspense, and unforgettable scares. Experience both films as they were meant to be seen--on the big screen.
85600.cast: Hiroyuki Sanada, Megumi Okina, Misaki Ito, Nanako Matsushima

85606.title: Eetha
85606.synopsis: Follows Vithabai Narayangaonkar, a renowned Marathi Tamasha and Lavani performer who rose from humble beginnings to become one of Maharashtra's most celebrated folk theatre artists.
85606.cast: MOHD. Zeeshan Ayyub, Randeep Hooda, Shraddha Kapoor

85607.title: A Fox Under a Pink Moon
85607.synopsis: At just 16 years old, strong-willed Afghan sculptor and illustrator Soraya Akhlaghi has spent five years trying to find a way out of Iran and join her mother in Europe. Trapped in a marriage to a violent man, Soraya escapes the brutality and isolation of her daily life through art, channeling all her worries, joys, and fears into stunning drawings and sculptures. Many of her creations feature recurring figures: a clown who never laughs, a pink moon that always watches over her, and a fox who is her loyal travel companion. Crafted from years of Soraya's own cell phone footage and video calls with co-director Mehrdad Oskouei, this textured self-portrait interweaves Soraya's artwork with riveting scenes of her escape attempts, political news from Afghanistan, and videos where she sings, dances, or defiantly shows her bruises. A diary, a survival story, and an artistic manifesto, A Fox Under a Pink Moon is an unforgettable testament to the creative resilience of a 16-year-old girl who refuses to be reduced to her circumstances. Winner of over 30 prizes at major festivals around the world, including Best Documentary at IDFA and Full Frame.

85608.title: WWE Survivor Series: WarGames 2026
85608.synopsis: Let the games begin! Don't miss Roman Reigns, Chelsea Green and all your favorites at Survivor Series: WarGames live in theaters Saturday, November 28th at 6E / 3P.

85609.title: A Little Dream of Me
85609.synopsis: Young dreamers chase music from Hoi An and Saigon to Busan and New York, only to learn that growing up asks a harder question: not what you want to chase, but who you want beside you while you chase it. A musical romance with 18 original songs.
85609.cast: Huu Chau, Tran Doan Hoang, Vo Phan Kim Khanh

85610.title: Summer School, 2001
85610.synopsis: After ten years in Vietnam, red-haired 17-year-old Kien comes home to Cheb, a Czech border town where his family runs a stall at the Vietnamese market. His father is distant, his mother is trying to make up for lost time, and his little brother isn't ready to share the spotlight. Over one chaotic summer, a family that learned to live apart has to figure out how to be one again.
85610.cast: Bui The Duong, Doan Hoang Anh, To Tien Tai

85615.title: AMC Scream Unseen: December 21
85615.synopsis: Be first to see a new scare with AMC Scream Unseen! We will share the movie’s MPA rating ahead of time, but the feature presentation will remain a mystery until showtime. Share your reaction after the movie with #AMCScreenUnseen on Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, Threads and X.

85622.title: Josephine: Early Access Screening
85622.synopsis: After 8-year-old Josephine accidentally witnesses a crime in Golden Gate Park, she acts out in search of a way to regain control of her safety, while adults are helpless to console her.

85647.title: Gunmaaster G9
85647.synopsis: The narrative follows Eshwar (played by Emraan Hashmi), a simple family man and dedicated devotee of Lord Shiva who works in the dairy trade and leads a peaceful life alongside his wife, Aarti. However, when a ruthless criminal underworld syndicate targets his loved ones, Eshwar is pushed to his absolute limit. Forced to unleash his buried, lethal persona and lethal close-range gun combat skills, he goes to extreme measures to protect the woman he desires from a dangerous network led by the villainous Desu Rathi band of honor-bound thieves who get entangled in a high-stakes gold smuggling heist. Hired as mercenaries, they must navigate a treacherous web of urban chaos, luxury car chases, and deadly close-quarter shootouts.

85675.synopsis:
First released in 1985, RATE IT X stunned audiences and critics alike with its unflinching look at how sexism and sexual exploitation are embedded in American media and culture. Directors Lucy Winer and Paula de Koenigsberg traveled across the United States interviewing men who profited from--and helped perpetuate--stereotyped and sexualized images of women. Advertising executives describe how sex is used to sell products. Hustler magazine's creator of the notorious 'Chester the Molester' cartoon proudly displays drawings depicting a predatory adult man entrapping young girls. A fundamentalist minister tells us that Adam shirked his responsibility by allowing Eve to lead. The flamboyant producer of a popular cable show roams the streets of New York City in a silver lame jumpsuit, video camera in hand, asking young women, "Would you like to flex into a hallway and pose nude?"

Applauded for its keen humor, Rate It X is now digitally restored and rereleased, remaining as provocative and relevant as ever. Despite decades of hard-fought victories in the women's movement, women's rights continue to face renewed challenges, and many of the cultural attitudes the film exposes remain deeply embedded. At a moment when political battles over sex discrimination and civil liberties intensify, the film's confrontational lens feels newly urgent. As public demands grow for greater transparency and accountability surrounding the sexual abuse and exploitation of minors, RATE IT X stands as a powerful reminder of why exposing these dynamics--and questioning the culture that sustains them--remains essential.

Many of her creations feature recurring figures: a clown who never laughs, a pink moon that always watches over her, and a fox who is her loyal travel companion. Crafted from years of Soraya's own cell phone footage and video calls with co-director Mehrdad Oskouei, this textured self-portrait interweaves Soraya's artwork with riveting scenes of her escape attempts, political news from Afghanistan, and videos where she sings, dances, or defiantly shows her bruises. Trapped in the wreckage, injured and helpless, he hangs suspended between life and death. When a mysterious poacher (Jason Williamson) discovers him, no rescue comes?only a watchful, unsettling presence that seems intent on letting nature finish the job. As the hours stretch and the elements close in, survival hinges on outlasting both the wilderness and the predator at its edge.

announced.title: Train (dir. Mysskin)
announced.synopsis: Follows a man who fights against armed personnel on a moving train in an attempt to rescue hostages.

announced.title: Die Hard (4DX 2026 re)
announced.synopsis: An NYPD officer tries to save his wife and several others taken hostage by German terrorists during a Christmas party at the Nakatomi Plaza in Los Angeles.
announced.cast: Alan Rickman, Bonnie Bedelia, Bruce Willis

announced.title: Above the Below
announced.synopsis: In this tense thriller, three astronauts (Idris Elba, Caitlin FitzGerald, and Hero Fiennes Tiffin) return to Earth only to discover their fight for survival has just begun. Directed by Idris Elba and Martin Owen, the film follows the crew after their damaged spacecraft is violently hurled through the atmosphere and plunges into the depths of the ocean. With oxygen rapidly running out and hope fading, they are forced to make an unthinkable choice: who will risk everything to reach the surface...and who will remain behind with the wreckage below.
announced.cast: Idris Elba

announced.title: Many Many Happy Returns
announced.synopsis: The film centers around a group of close-knit childhood friends reuniting in their picturesque hometown for an elaborate, week-long wedding celebration. As old sparks fly and long-buried secrets surface, the joyful occasion quickly turns chaotic, forcing the friends to confront unresolved heartbreaks, career anxieties, and the changing dynamics of their relationships.
announced.cast: Kalidas Jayaram, Lakshmi Jyothish

announced.title: Popiwa

announced.cast: Carlos Cruz, Luis Polonia, Papi Rosswil

announced.title: Rose
announced.synopsis: In the turmoil of the Thirty-Years' War, a mysterious soldier appears in a secluded Protestant village claiming to be heir to a long-abandoned manor. His quest for recognition and acceptance are complicated by his secret: under a false identity, false name, and pretense of a false gender, he has made his way to the village. But to achieve her goals, Rose, as the soldier is actually called, will stop at nothing.
announced.cast: Caro Braun, Sandra Huller

announced.title: The Odyssey
announced.synopsis: Christopher Nolan's next film, THE ODYSSEY, is a mythic action epic shot across the world using brand new IMAX film technology. The film brings Homer's foundational saga to IMAX film screens for the first time

announced.title: Summer School, 2001
announced.synopsis: After ten years in Vietnam, red-haired 17-year-old Kien comes home to Cheb, a Czech border town where his family runs a stall at the Vietnamese market. His father is distant, his mother is trying to make up for lost time, and his little brother isn't ready to share the spotlight. Over one chaotic summer, a family that learned to live apart has to figure out how to be one again.
announced.cast: Bui The Duong, Doan Hoang Anh, To Tien Tai

announced.title: Jean-Michel Basquiat
announced.synopsis: Jean-Michel Basquiat is a reclamation of what has been lost in the legacy of a globally renowned artist. Through untold memories from close friends and family, never-before-seen works, and rare archival imagery, this film demystifies the story of Basquiat and discovers the man behind it all, Jean-Michel.

announced.title: Rayavalasa
announced.synopsis:
Set against the nostalgic backdrop of an early 2000s Telugu village, Rayavalasa is an emotionally engaging rural drama that brings together love, friendship, family relationships, village rivalries, and unexpected twists.The story revolves around Raju, a kind-hearted young man who lives with his grandmother, cherishing his friendships and leading a simple life while carrying the emotional burden of his parents' tragic past. His peaceful world takes an unexpected turn when Rani, the village president's daughter, returns from the city with a dream of establishing a school for the village children. As their destinies become intertwined, long-standing political rivalries, jealousy, ego, and hidden agendas begin to disrupt the harmony of the village. A carefully planned conspiracy puts Raju and Rani's reputations at stake, triggering a chain of unexpected events that changes their lives forever. Caught between love, friendship, betrayal, and powerful village politics, Raju must confront injustice and fight to protect his dignity, relationships, and everything he holds dear.
Blending rooted Telugu nativity, nostalgic village celebrations, vibrant folk music, heartfelt emotions, and gripping dramatic twists, Rayavalasa promises an engaging theatrical experience that celebrates the innocence of village life while exploring the complexities of human relationships.
announced.cast: Anitha Chowdary, Karthik Jayanthi, Sreesha Nulu

announced.title: Secret Lives of Baba Segi's Wives
announced.synopsis: A rich patriarch's delicate family falls apart when his youngest of four wives cannot have a child.
announced.cast: Bimbo Ademoye, Mercy Aigbe, Odunlade Adekola

announced.title: Project Hail Mary (RE26)
announced.synopsis: Science teacher Ryland Grace (Ryan Gosling) wakes up on a spaceship light years from home with no recollection of who he is or how he got there. As his memory returns, he begins to uncover his mission: solve the riddle of the mysterious substance causing the sun to die out. He must call on his scientific knowledge and unorthodox ideas to save everything on Earth from extinction… but an unexpected friendship means he may not have to do it alone.

announced.synopsis: When Mona Friedman is cast in a bit part at a small community theater, she transforms from a shy, unassuming housewife into a zealous method actor willing to do anything to protect the artistic integrity of her marginal role--even if it means waging war against the show's domineering director.
announced.cast: Halle Bailey, Julianne Moore, Paul Giamatti

announced.title: Tender Loving Care
announced.synopsis: Palme d'Or winner and Academy Award nominee Mike Leigh returns with his next feature film, continuing his insightful exploration of the contemporary world. With his distinctive cinematic voice, he once again delves into themes that challenge and resonate with modern audiences.
announced.cast: Kate O'Flynn, Marion Bailey, Paul Jesson

announced.cast: Claire Foy, Guy Pearce, Jack O'Connell

announced.title: Gursheed Moahamad Singh
announced.synopsis: Set during the 1947 Partition of India, the film shows a time when people faced fear, violence and the pain of leaving their homes. As communities were divided, some people chose to stand together and help one another. Through the lives of its characters, the film explores family, faith, identity and human relationships. It highlights how kindness and compassion can bring people together, even in the most difficult situations. Gursheed Mohamad Singh is a story about humanity, love and the message that people should always come before religion.
announced.cast: Gursharan Singh Sodhi, Ranjit Singh, Sanju Solanki

announced.title: Gradiva, La
announced.synopsis: A class of high school students travels to Pompeii to discover ruins and bodies petrified by Vesuvius. announced.cast: Colas Quignard, Suzanne Gerin

announced.cast: David Corenswet, Michael Shannon

announced.title: Jumanji: Open World
announced.synopsis: This Christmas, Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart, and Karen Gillan are reunited in Jumanji: Open World, the hilarious final installment of the globally beloved action-adventure trilogy. Our heroes have escaped the perilous jungles of Jumanji before, but this time Jumanji breaks free of its console, unleashing its chaos into our world.
announced.cast: Dwayne Johnson, Jack Black, Kevin Hart

The film follows a young man navigating family responsibilities, financial challenges, and personal relationships, offering an engaging story with strong emotional appeal.
announced.cast: Devika Bhat, Kiran Abbavaram, Sai Kumar

announced.title: Werwulf
announced.synopsis: Witness Robert Eggers’ most visceral and haunting experience yet. Focus Features presents WERWULF, a harrowing tale of devotion, damnation and the devil within.

announced.title: Coward
announced.synopsis: Set at the height of World War I in the shadows of the Belgian trenches, Lukas Dhont's COWARD unfolds as an epic, intimate journey of youthful self discovery through love, art, and survival. Pierre arrives at the front lines as a young soldier eager to find his footing in a world consumed by violence. Everything changes when he meets Francis, a kindred spirit whose vision of staging a front-line theater show unlocks a world Pierre never knew existed. What begins as a fleeting escape from the harsh reality of the trenches soon blossoms into a tender, emotional love story, anchored by the undeniable chemistry of breakout actors Emmanuel Macchia and Valentin Campagne. As the world burns around them, their stage becomes a sanctuary of innocence and devotion. COWARD beautifully explores the fine line between fear and fortitude for soldiers in search of a promised glory, ultimately asking: when the world demands brutality, is walking away for love the truest act of bravery?
announced.cast: Emmanuel Macchia, Valentin Campagne

announced.title: Look Back
announced.synopsis:
Confident grade-schooler Fujino draws comics for her school newspaper, earning the admiration of her classmates. When her artwork is surpassed by her reclusive peer Kyomoto, she becomes obsessed with honing her skills, eventually burning out and giving up drawing altogether. But when Fujino finally meets Kyomoto, she discovers that Kyomoto has been her devoted fan all along. Bound by their shared passion, they spend irreplaceable years drawing manga together until a fateful event changes their lives forever.

From Palme d'Or winner Hirokazu Koreeda, Look Back is a love letter to the artistic process, hand-written in ink on paper, and a meditation on how mutual pursuit of a craft creates the deepest etches in our memory.
announced.cast: Miyu Sasaki, Ryo Ikeda

announced.title: Pendulum
announced.synopsis: Married couple Patrick (Gordon-Levitt) and Abigail (Dynevor) travel to a secluded New Mexico retreat seeking healing after a traumatic event. But as Abigail falls deeper under the influence of the retreat's enigmatic leader (Weaver), Patrick begins to suspect something far more sinister lurks beneath the group's spiritual promises. As paranoia spirals into terror, the couple uncovers a horrifying truth that may consume them both before they can escape.
announced.cast: Joseph Gordon-Levitt, Norman Reedus, Phoebe Dynevor

announced.title: Japon - lumiere d'automne - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: Immerse yourself in the heart of a fascinating country where ancient traditions and modernity coexist in perfect harmony. From bustling metropolises like Tokyo to serene places like Kyoto, this journey unveils the many facets of the Japanese archipelago. Through encounters and discoveries, the film leads us to iconic sites steeped in history and emotion, such as Hiroshima and the sacred island of Miyajima, as well as to more peaceful regions, including the majestic landscapes of the Japanese Alps. Between ancient temples, ultramodern cities, and breathtaking panoramas bathed in the colors of autumn, our adventurers Serge and Johanne offer a sensitive and authentic perspective on Japan.

announced.title: Cliffhanger
announced.synopsis: The film follows Ray Cooper, a seasoned mountaineer who runs a luxury chalet in the Dolomites with his daughter. When a weekend excursion with a billionaire's son turns violent, they are targeted by a group of kidnappers. As the attack unfolds, Ray's daughter, Naomi, still haunted by a tragic climbing accident, escapes into the mountains and must fight for survival against both nature and her pursuers. CLIFFHANGER delivers a contemporary take on the beloved high-altitude thriller.
announced.cast: Lily James, Nell Tiger Free, Pierce Brosnan

announced.title: Hurricanna
announced.synopsis: In the hours surrounding a glamorous appearance at a championship boxing match, supermodel Anna Nicole Smith, her psychiatrist, and her lover form a disastrous trio and descend towards chaos.
announced.cast: Holly Hunter, Mark Duplass, Sylvia Hoeks

announced.title: Billy Knight
announced.synopsis: When his estranged father dies, film student Alex Hubbs (Charlie Heaton) is left with one clue: a handkerchief bearing a name Hollywood has forgotten. Billy Knight. As his best friend Emily (Diana Silvers) watches him drift, Alex chases the name into a Beverly Hills mansion and meets the man himself (Al Pacino), a legendary director erased from history. What Billy offers him is everything he's ever wanted, and the closer Alex gets, the harder it becomes to tell where Billy's world ends and his own life begins.
announced.cast: Al Pacino, Charlie Heaton, Diana Silvers

announced.title: Ugly Cry
announced.synopsis: UGLY CRY is a darkly comic horror film about Delaney, a struggling actress who becomes obsessed with a role she?s auditioning for after learning the producers think she has an 'ugly cry.' As she tries to make her cry prettier, she spirals down a dark and dangerous path to perfection.
announced.cast: Aaron Dominguez, Emily Robinson, Ryan Simpkins

announced.title: Everybody Digs Bill Evans
announced.synopsis: June 1961, New York. Legendary jazz pianist Bill Evans has found his musical voice and created the perfect trio, including bass player Scott LaFaro, his musical soulmate. A residency at New York's Village Vanguard culminates in the live taping of two of the greatest jazz records of all time in one day. Days later, LaFaro dies tragically in a car crash. Numb with grief, Evans stops playing for the first time since childhood. This is the story of what happened next for one of the most influential and gifted figures in 20th Century music. Grant Gee won Best Director at the 2026 Berlin International Film Festival.
announced.cast: Anders Danielsen Lie, Bill Pullman, Laurie Metcalf

announced.title: The Liberation
announced.synopsis: Rita (Coon), a woman in midlife haunted by the weight of her past, encounters magnetic young spiritual leader Ricki (James) and leaves her family to follow her to an all-female commune. But when her daughters Ella (Ramsey) and Jo (Young) arrive unexpectedly and become drawn into the group's seductive world, Rita is forced to choose between the family she left behind and the life she believes can save her.
announced.cast: Bella Ramsey, Carrie Coon, Lily James

announced.title: January 12 Vidudala

Two Army officers and best friends, Venkat Reddy and Bal Reddy are very efficient in handling crises situation regarding national defense. when Bal Reddy returns to his native village, he encounters unexpected rift in within a family divided by tradition, identity, and pride. Venkat reddy steps in to heal the growing rift, but faces unimaginable difficulties in process.
This setup against the vibrant backdrop of Rayalaseema, the story blends action, romance, humor, and family drama sacrifice, and the enduring power of love, friendship,
announced.cast: Keerthy Suresh, Nandamuri Kalyan Ram, Venkatesh Daggubati

announced.synopsis: In the epic fantasy world of Orïsha, a young woman goes on a quest to reclaim the magic that was violently stolen from her people. announced.cast: Amandla Stenberg, Thuso Mbedu

announced.cast: Javier Bardem, Penelope Cruz, Stephen Graham

announced.title: River
announced.synopsis:
The sun is down.  The boat is dead.  There's no cell service.  And there's someone standing, staring, from both shores.  Written and directed by Joshua Giuliano, RIVER stars Jane Levy (Evil Dead), Jessica Rothe (Happy Death Day) and Max Mattern (Devil in Disguise: John Wayne Gacy) as three estranged siblings who reunite in their hometown after the death of their father. As they set out to scatter his ashes at his favorite spot on a remote river, the trip devolves into a waking nightmare. Dane DiLiegro (Prey) also stars in the film.

Currently with a 94% critics rating on Rotten Tomatoes, RIVER was acquired by Universal Pictures and Blumhouse Atomic Monster following an electrifying launch at Midnight Madness at the Toronto International Film Festival. This release establishes a meaningful, new collaboration between Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster, Independent Film Company and Shudder, bringing them together for the expanded theatrical release of Joshua Giuliano's debut feature. 

Universal Pictures, Blumhouse Atomic Monster and Independent Film Company present RIVER, a Shudder Original Production, in association with Upgrade. RIVER is produced by Spooky Pictures' Steven Schneider and Eat the Cat's Nick Antosca and Alex Hedlund. The film is executive produced by Allegheny Image Factory's Jeffrey Tinnell and Robert Tinnell, Upgrade's Matt Brodlie and Jonathan Kier, Ben Ross and Blumhouse Atomic Monster's Jason Blum.
announced.cast: Jane Levy, Jessica Rothe, Max Mattern

announced.title: Exhibition on Screen: Renoir & Love
announced.synopsis:
Pierre-Auguste Renoir is one of the world's favourite artists; a founding member of the Impressionist movement and a constantly evolving artist, he is unmatched at depicting human connection. The National Gallery's blockbuster exhibition brings together vibrant masterpieces which explore love in all its forms, bringing colour and warmth into the cold winter months.

With exclusive access to this exciting new show, Exhibition on Screen will bring these world class works to cinema audiences, with close examination of the art and leading experts exploring the immense skill and influence of this master of colour and connection. Be transported back to a Parisian summer of love through the eyes of a true visionary. An unmissable opportunity to fall in love with Renoir this winter.

announced.title: Ringu & Ju-On: The Grudge Double Feature
announced.synopsis: Two of Japan's most iconic horror films return to the big screen for one terrifying double feature! In RINGU, a television journalist investigates a cursed videotape that kills anyone who watches it within seven days, leading her to a chilling encounter with the vengeful spirit Sadako. In JU-ON: THE GRUDGE, a social worker enters a seemingly ordinary home, only to discover a sinister curse and the terrifying presence of Kayako. Together, these groundbreaking J-horror classics redefined the genre with their haunting imagery, relentless suspense, and unforgettable scares. Experience both films as they were meant to be seen--on the big screen.
announced.cast: Hiroyuki Sanada, Megumi Okina, Misaki Ito, Nanako Matsushima

Alongside his complicated father, and with their small mountain community rallying together against the unforgiving winter, Mike embarks on a search that leads him toward an unexpected journey of self-discovery, belonging and the quiet strength required to carry on.

announced.title: INDE les Mysteres du Gange - Les aventuriers voyageurs
announced.synopsis: After captivating audiences with their Italian saga, Michele and Martin radically change scenery to immerse themselves in the intensity of Northern India. From the vibrant energy of Delhi to the sacred banks of the Ganges, and on to the breathtaking panoramas of the Himalayas, they reveal an India that is both vibrant and profoundly human. Amidst flamboyant colors, age-old traditions, and the seething energy of the streets, the journey also offers moments of tranquility and pure emotion. Enchanting ceremonies, unforgettable encounters, majestic temples, and authentic scenes of daily life: this new film invites you to see, feel, and experience India? in a new way.

announced.title: Slayground

announced.title: Maserati: The Brothers
announced.synopsis: The name Maserati, renowned in the world of car racing and manufacturing, is more than just that. This is the story of the Maserati family company's modest, yet proud beginning, and the journey they took for that name to become so established - from its founding in 1914, to the struggle to keep the business and their lives intact, to the legend it is today.
announced.cast: Andy Garcia, Anthony Hopkins, Jessica Alba

announced.title: Witch on the Holy Night
announced.synopsis:
Aoko Aozaki, an ordinary high school girl, is actually a Magician who lives in the modern world...though she is still only an apprentice. As she spends her days living alongside her housemate, Alice Kuonji, striving to become a full-fledged Magician...

The girl meets a boy.

This is the beginning of one young girl's story -- the tale of a Witch.

announced.synopsis: From producer Chad Stahelski (John Wick franchise), and written and directed by Takashi Doscher, KAROSHI is an action-thriller set in a near-future Manhattan, where corporate loyalty and cultural tradition have reshaped everyday life. When a mysterious outsider infiltrates a powerful company after a worker's death, he exposes the violent system hidden beneath its polished surface. Starring Teo Yoo (Past Lives), Isabel May (Scream 7), Takehiro Hira ("Sh?gun"), Bill Camp ("Presumed Innocent"), Show Kasamatsu ("Tokyo Vice"), Giancarlo Esposito ("Breaking Bad"), and Cynthia Erivo (Wicked). Produced by Jason Spitz, Alex Young, and Nathan Kahane.
announced.cast: Isabel May, Takehiro Hira, Teo Yoo

announced.title: The Comeback King
announced.synopsis:
The film, about a country western star in free fall, is set to star Glen Powell and Cristin Milioti. Judd Apatow will direct. Apatow and Powell wrote the script together.

Apatow will produce through his longstanding Apatow Productions overall deal with the Studio. Apatow's relationship with the Studio dates back to his 2005 directorial debut, The 40-Year-Old Virgin, and he has since directed Knocked Up, Funny People, This is 40, Trainwreck and The King of Staten Island for the Studio.

Powell and Dan Cohen will produce through Barnstorm's first look deal with the Studio. Powell's relationship with the Studio originates with his starring role in Twisters, which overperformed against all industry expectations, becoming the biggest opening for a natural disaster film ever at the domestic box office and grossing $267.8 million overall in the domestic box office.

Kevin Misher will produce through Misher Films. Misher has a storied history with Universal Pictures, where he was President of Production from 1996-2001 and supervised production for some of the Studio's most acclaimed features, including Erin Brockovich, The Fast and the Furious, Meet the Parents, and The Mummy. Misher subsequently formed Misher Films, where he has been producing a variety of films over the past two decades, including Fighting With My Family, Coming 2 America and You People.
announced.cast: Cristin Milioti, Glen Powell

announced.title: Remain

announced.title: Kristina Kuzmic - Hope & Humor
